payload.text: POST-3.2.1 BACKLOG, not in the cut (from molt-vc, 2026-09-23, sent at hv's request): (1) a SUPPORTED QUERY for the gate's resolved install root. Molt copies the shim's resolution to check it: the pointer under XDG_DATA_HOME, lib/templates under it, and on brew a realpath match with opt/intent/libexec. The shim's --where answers per project only, and intent info reports the running binary's root, not the pointer's. An intent info line or intent bootstrap --check reporting the pointer and whether it resolves would let Molt ask Intent instead. (2) An observation: the version string cannot tell a release from a dev build (both print 'intent 3.2.0 (<hash>)'). File each as its own issue or thread after the cut, if hv wants them.
